decision: Place New conversation and New terminal side by side within the project context. A terminal is a distinct session type in the shared workspace, not a conversation skin.
creation: Use the selected project's workspace/root. Project-level actions open a tab in the main window; local pane actions open in that pane. Preserve the existing single-project prototype boundary.
presentation: Distinct terminal icon and PowerShell label in tabs/navigation; project and working directory visible inside the terminal; no conversation composer/model/approval controls in terminal panes.
interaction: Mixed conversation and terminal tabs participate in existing split, drag, focus and auxiliary-window return. Preserve command draft, output history, caret, shell metadata and scroll.
responsive: Creation actions remain adjacent in the project drawer on phones. Pane menu offers local terminal creation when compact chrome hides its icon. The terminal pane uses its actual container dimensions.
boundary: Browser fixture terminal. Explicit demo badge; no PTY, provider, process, filesystem or command execution. Arbitrary commands are displayed as text, never evaluated. Real terminal lifecycle integration remains a product task.
validation: Existing R7 regression suite plus terminal creation, project metadata, mixed-layout state, popup return, mobile visibility and automated accessibility checks. No performance benchmark.
